exposure: Country of residence (Australia, Ireland, United Kingdom)
outcome: Infant feeding mode (any breastfeeding vs. no breastfeeding)
cohort: 2047 adult women with at least one infant less than 6 months of age
finding: After adjusting for known factors associated with breastfeeding, country differences in infant feeding mode remained, with lower breastfeeding rates in Ireland and the United Kingdom compared to Australia.
mod_finding: The odds of being in the 'no breastfeeding' group increased when the baby was delivered via caesarean section in Australia.
followup_time: Infants less than 6 months of age
